_purpose: TEST ENVIRONMENTAL OBJECT SPAWNING - Verify env objects reduce target hallucination by making terminals, doors, cargo explicitly spawnable. ALL AGENTS USE OPENAI GPT-5-MINI TEMP 1.0.
session_name: Server Room Infiltration - Environmental Objects Test (OpenAI)
_comment_tactical: === TACTICAL MODULE - DISABLED (Focus on Environment Interaction) ===
_comment_scenario: === SCENARIO: CORPORATE SERVER ROOM - RICH ENVIRONMENT ===
_scenario_hint: Tempest Corp Server Room (void_level 1, abandoned maintenance shift). Location has MANY interactive environmental features: security terminals (need hacking), sealed maintenance doors (need unlock/force), server racks (can be disabled), cargo containers of backup drives (need opening), control panels, airlock systems, emergency override stations. Team goals: extract corporate secrets, disable security, find hidden data. Players will naturally mention wanting to 'hack the terminal', 'open the door', 'search the cargo' - DM should spawn these as environmental objects to test the system. Security is offline but systems are locked, requiring environmental interaction.

_design_notes.test_hypothesis: Environmental object spawning reduces target hallucination. When players say 'I hack the terminal', DM spawns EnvObjectSpawn(object_type='terminal',...) making it explicit rather than pure narrative.
success_criteria: DM spawns env objects when players mention environmental features
Players see env objects in entities_present display
No 'target not found' errors for spawned objects
Environmental features are explicitly tracked vs narrative flavor
_design_notes.llm_provider: ALL AGENTS USE OPENAI GPT-5-MINI TEMP 1.0 - Maximum creativity for DM spawning, consistent player actions.
